title: memory backends: one CallerCtx so a single Dispatcher can host every family
description: (b1, high) Reference memory backends use different CallerCtx types ((), Id, String), so no single Dispatcher hosts them; a bridge handler loses conditional-02 for bridged families (atomic Mailbox/set refused). Found by the toy-consumer check (docs/audits/2026-11-20-toy-consumers/README.md).
